name: @publicdomainrelay/lexicons
description: TypeScript types, NSID constants, and embedded lexicon docs for com.publicdomainrelay.* — derived from the JSON lexicon files in ./lexicons/.

scripts.build: cd $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && goat lex pull com.atproto.repo.strongRef && deno x -A -y npm:@atproto/lex build --override --import-ext ".ts" --lexicons ./lexicons --out src/typescript/lib/lexicons
